ADMIN WORKSPACE

Your FI admin dashboard.

A private overview of products, pricing, enquiries, fulfilment and sales. Access stays limited to approved FI administrators.

Products & pricing ↗Warehouse & orders ↗Supplier review ↗Enquiries ↓

Sales totals include live warehouse-order payments only. Test payments and older unlinked payment-history records are excluded. Service fees are shown before refunds and operating costs; they are not net profit.

Sales & marketing overview

Monthly sales are grouped by payment month. Refunds shown are the current refunds against those orders. Category demand counts purchased units before returns.

Website traffic and campaign conversion measurements will appear once analytics is configured. The message experiment remains deferred.

Order catalogue & source pricing

Confirm the manufacturer unit price and AUD exchange rate in the product editor. FI adds the 10% source-price fee and all agreed costs when approving the customer’s final quote.

Supplier submissions

Review company and product details before connecting a submission to a published product.

Website research catalogue

These are the products currently listed on the public website. Open one in the editor to connect or prepare its order-catalogue record. Existing demonstration prices and test checkout links remain separate from an approved live quote.

Enquiries & applications

New buyer notes, supplier introductions and team applications are saved here. Replies are handled through the team inbox; saving a status does not send an email.

Earlier saved enquiries

Older email-only messages remain in the team inbox.

All orders

Use the operations workspace to confirm quotes and manage warehouse inspection and onward delivery.

Return cases

Recorded case statuses and refund amounts. Open the relevant order for its payment and fulfilment details.
